facts.business: JTL Defence Limited manufactures specialized copper and copper alloy products such as copper strips and foils for critical sectors including defence, engineering, electrical, construction, automotive, renewables, and infrastructure.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) Revaluation of Property, Plant and Equipment (Land, Buildings, Plant & Machinery) during the year ended 31st March 2026 per Ind AS 16; (b) Recovery of financial assets (trade receivables, debtors, securities) outstanding from Insolvency Resolution Proceedings, with management actively pursuing recovery in FY 2026-27; (c) Settlement of liabilities and transfer of resultant gain to Capital Reserve; (d) Notices from Taxation Authorities for pre-NCLT periods, which management believes fall under immunity granted by the NCLT order approving the Resolution Plan.
